question: Mirabai Chanu secured a silver medal at which Commonwealth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Mirabai Chanu won the silver medal at the **2014 Commonwealth Games** held in Glasgow, Scotland.

• This was a significant achievement in her career as it marked her emergence on the international stage.

• In the 48 kg weightlifting category, she lifted a total of 170 kg to secure the silver medal.

• Her performance at the 2014 Commonwealth Games laid the foundation for her future success in international weightlifting competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Commonwealth Games**

• The Commonwealth Games is an international multi-sport event involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.

• The event was first held in 1930 and takes place every four years.

• It is one of the largest sports events in the world in terms of the number of athletes participating.

• The Games are overseen by the Commonwealth Games Federation (CGF), which is responsible for the direction and control of the Commonwealth Games.

• The Commonwealth Games feature a wide range of sports, including athletics, swimming, rugby sevens, and weightlifting.

• **Mirabai Chanu**

• Saikhom Mirabai Chanu is an Indian weightlifter born on August 8, 1994, in Manipur, India.

• She has won several medals in international competitions, including the World Weightlifting Championships and the Commonwealth Games.

• She is known for her strength and dedication to the sport, making her one of India's top weightlifters.

• Her achievements have inspired many young athletes in India to pursue weightlifting.

• **Weightlifting Categories**

• Weightlifting competitions are divided into various weight categories to ensure fair competition among athletes of similar body weights.

• In the 2014 Commonwealth Games, Mirabai Chanu competed in the 48 kg weight category.

• Each weight category has specific weight limits, and athletes must weigh in before the competition to ensure they qualify for their respective categories.

• Weightlifting consists of two main lifts: the snatch and the clean and jerk. The combined total of these two lifts determines the athlete's final score.
